calc.help:
🧮 *Calculator*

*Usage:* `!calc <expression>`
or reply to a message containing an expression with `!calc`

*Operators:* `+` `-` `*` `/` `%` (modulo) `^` (power) `!` (factorial)
*Percentages:* `15%` · `20% of 300`
*Constants:* `pi` · `e` · `tau`
*Functions:* sqrt, cbrt, abs, round, floor, ceil, ln, log, log2, exp,
sin, cos, tan, sind, cosd, tand, asin, acos, atan, deg, rad,
pow, root, hypot, min, max, avg, sum, fact

*Examples:*
`!calc (12 + 8) * 3`
`!calc 2^10`
`!calc 25% of 480`
`!calc sqrt(144) + 5!`
`!calc max(3, 9, 4) * pi`

digit.help:
🔢 *Digit converter*

• `{prefix}digit 12345` ➔ ١٢٣٤٥  (auto-detected)
• `{prefix}digit ١٢٣٤٥` ➔ 12345
• `{prefix}digit ar 12345` ➔ ١٢٣٤٥
• `{prefix}digit en ١٢٣٤٥` ➔ 12345
_Or reply to a message with digits in it using `{prefix}digit` — it converts the other way._
_When Arabic and English digits are mixed, say which way: `{prefix}digit ar` or `{prefix}digit en`._

loop.help:
🔁 *Loop*

*Usage:*
`!loop <count> <text>` — repeat the text in one message
`!loop <from>-<to>` — print the numbers from/to
`!loop <from>-<to>:<step>` — with a custom step

*Options:*
`-s` separate messages instead of one
`-n` no numbering

*Placeholders in the text:*
`{n}` the current number · `{i}` the repetition number

*Examples:*
`!loop 5 hello`
`!loop 1-10`
`!loop 0-100:25 counter {n}`
`!loop 3 good morning -s`

_At most {maxItems} repetitions in one message, {maxSplit} separate messages._
rand.help:
🎲 *Random*

`!rand` a number from 1 to 100
`!rand <max>` a number from 1 to that number
`!rand <min> <max>` a number between the two
`!rand dice [count d sides]` dice — e.g. `!rand dice 2d6`
`!rand coin` heads or tails
`!rand pick option | option | option` picks one
